title: Chef's Signature Collection
intro: Real menus from our resident chefs, priced per person and tailored to your event.
vatNote: All prices are exclusive of 5% VAT.

addOns.name: Cuisine tea/ritual pairing (karak, gahwa, matcha, kahwa)

terms.vat: All prices are exclusive of 5% VAT.
terms.groupPricing: Signature menus carry a flat per-person rate for any party of 2–20 guests; the rate is confirmed at quote.
terms.serviceWindow: Chef arrives ~1 hour before service; table service runs 2.5–3.5 hours depending on the menu.
terms.staffing: 1 waiter per 10 guests included; additional waiters available as an add-on.
terms.kitchenRequirements: Working stove, oven, fridge and sink. We bring all specialty equipment, ingredients and plating ware.
terms.alcohol: Alcohol is supplied by the client. Pairing guidance, sommelier and bartender services are available as add-ons. All menus are halal by default.
terms.marketNote: Lobster, caviar, bluefin tuna, A5 wagyu and seasonal truffle are subject to market price at the time of booking.
terms.customization: All menus are fully customisable; dietary, halal, vegetarian and allergy protocols accommodated on request.
